purpose: Prospectively test one conservative symmetric positive semidefinite uniform-grid leading-order dispersion correction to an EXACT 56m3 roof cutcell finite-volume solver. No guarantee global fourth order on cutcells, and not native original PFFDTD repair.

frozen_input.original_native_q0: q[0]=1, all n>0 zero, original archived eight source weights normalized and unchanged

scheme.base: exact roof cutcell FV native x-yz Kronecker M/K, original 8/8 point source receiver, implicit beta=1/4 Newmark, original finite pressure derivative
scheme.candidate: M unchanged, K4 = K+(h^2/(12 c^2)) K M^{-1} K, no additional free coefficient, original point source RHS unchanged
scheme.all_modes: all PPW40 and PPW44 native exact-roof x⊗yz generalized eigenmodes; lambda4=lambda+(h^2/(12c^2))*lambda^2, includes all zero, low, and Nyquist/high modes
scheme.source_amplitude: original q0 * dt^2 c^2 * mass-orthonormal source/receiver coupling / (1+dt^2 lambda_candidate/4); no fitted amplitude
scheme.finite_record: exact analytic full native Newmark 250ms endpoint inclusive pressure/DTFT, no taper, no damping, no mode cut, no noise floor change
scheme.discrete_matrix_required: symmetric positive semidefinite, constant vector null, same diagonal positive M; K4 applied in true sparse M/K operator, check on independent 1D Neumann fixture
